description: Define a required explicit simulate/live execution mode for contract billing calculation.
Define a versioned normalized calculation input containing tenant, execution, client, document window, obligations, activity, tax, discounts, and adjustments.
Represent resolved contract obligations as a discriminated union with effective pricing, timing, proration, profile, source, and persistence identity.
Define a canonical calculated line containing stable identity, quantity/rate, net/tax/gross money, service period, explanation, markers, and persistence correlation.
Define a versioned calculation result containing canonical lines, discounts, adjustments, totals, diagnostics, currency, window, and execution trace fields.
Reject invalid tenant, date-window, currency, and normalized-obligation invariants before calculating charges.
Provide one deterministic calculateContractBilling entry point with no database, network, clock, random, logging, numbering, audit, or event dependencies.
Route fixed contract obligations through the shared calculation pipeline with existing effective pricing and proration behavior.
Route hourly contract obligations through the shared calculation pipeline with existing rate, minimum, rounding, overtime, and proration behavior.
Route usage contract obligations through the shared calculation pipeline with existing tier, minimum, unit, effective-rate, and proration behavior.
Route bucket contract obligations through the shared calculation pipeline with explicit incoming and outgoing allowance/rollover state.
Route product and license recurring-quantity obligations through the shared calculation pipeline with existing cadence, price, and tax behavior.
Apply discounts and adjustments exactly once to canonical calculated charges in the shared pipeline.
Calculate subtotal, tax total, and final total from integer minor-unit canonical lines in the shared pipeline.
Generate stable charge keys and structured explanations inside the shared engine so callers do not reconstruct internal identities.
Load production contract billing data with tenant-scoped queries into normalized input without changing effective-date or due-period selection behavior.
Load simulator scenarios, hypothetical service periods, and synthetic activity into the same normalized input without implementing financial formulas.
Resolve tax and billing-profile context before pure calculation while preserving production provisioning and simulator read-only behavior.
Rewire production contract billing to load, invoke calculateContractBilling in live mode, and pass its result to existing persistence orchestration.
Preserve production transaction pinning, source reconciliation, invoice persistence, recurring linkage, numbering, finalization, audit, analytics, and post-commit events.
Preserve production duplicate-invoice and recurring execution idempotency guards.
Rewire every simulated invoice period to invoke calculateContractBilling in simulate mode.
Map shared calculated results to the existing simulator timeline and invoice view model without recalculating monetary fields.
Prevent simulated results from entering live persistence through runtime validation and distinct types where practical.
prdRefs: Requirements > Explicit execution mode and side-effect boundary

description: Delete simulator-owned charge dispatch, synthetic dispatch glue, replicated explanation keys, discount reconstruction, and total calculation.
Prevent production and simulator callers from bypassing the shared entry point to directly orchestrate charge-family compute modules.
Fail closed on cross-tenant live references in simulator input rather than omitting affected lines.
Return structured diagnostics for invalid or unpriceable normalized obligations without silently excluding financial impact.
Document the shared billing boundary, extension procedure, side-effect boundary, and prohibited parallel financial paths.
